item.title: All Dublin Roads Could Be Limited To 30km/h
item.description: Almost all roads within the Dublin City Council area could be subject to a 30km/h speed limit by early next year, following a wide-ranging speed reduction assessment currently under way. The council is reviewing roads that still operate at 50km/h, 60km/h and 80km/h, with a public consultation on proposed changes expected to be launched in the coming months. item.description: Gardaí have revealed that almost 3,500 motorists were detected speeding during the St. Brigid’s Bank Holiday Weekend, with Bank Holiday Monday recording the highest number of offences, accounting for more than 800 detections in a single day. item.title: Meryl Streep To Play Joni Mitchell In Cameron Crowe Biopic
item.description: Meryl Streep is to star as Joni Mitchell in the new Cameron Crowe directed biopic about the singer. According to Rolling Stone magazine, record executive Clive Davis confirmed the casting at his pre Grammy awards party last Saturday (January 31) at the Beverly Hilton Hotel in Los Angeles. This report comes amid rumours had surfaced last year that Anya Taylor-Joy has been cast as a younger version of Mitchell. Casting of the younger version of the singer was not confirmed at the time of writing.

item.title: Dublin and southeast on flood alert as rain warnings issued
item.description: A Status Orange rain warning has been issued for Wicklow and Waterford, with a Yellow alert in place for nine other counties, as authorities warn of an increased risk of flooding across large parts of the country. The Yellow warning applies to Carlow, Dublin, Kildare, Kilkenny, Laois, Louth, Wexford, Monaghan and Tipperary. Both alerts will come into effect at 3am tomorrow and remain in place for 24 hours.
